description: Admin UI surface for managing mcp_policy_rules table. Must provide: (1) CRUD interface for policy rules with rule_type, pattern, action, and priority fields. (2) Table display of existing rules with sort/filter. (3) Form for creating new rules. (4) Delete with confirmation. (5) All writes via write_service POST :8772/write. (6) Audit log insertion on every write action. (7) Match visual style of admin_exemptions.html.
